title: (Men of Whom the World Was Not Worthy) Bunyan, John to Live Upon God That Is Invisible
description: In this sermon, the speaker discusses the life and sufferings of John Bunyan, a 17th-century English writer and preacher. Bunyan experienced numerous hardships, including the death of his mother and sister, military service, and struggles with his faith. However, he had a transformative moment when he realized that his righteousness came from Jesus Christ alone. Despite enduring imprisonment, criticism, and personal challenges, Bunyan remained steadfast in his faith and ministry. The speaker emphasizes the importance of trusting in God rather than relying on oneself, drawing from 2 Corinthians 1:9.
